summary: Checkpoint capture preflights scratch headroom; proof writes use a guarded SQLite VFS, report the controlling deficit, and clean owned proof files with checked errors

replay.detail: The same sealed set, drop plan, replay and proof comparisons run after admission.

schema.detail: No durable table or stored format changes. Proof owner markers and a lock are local scratch files.

rules.detail: RULES_VERSION, retention, other-claims validation and checkpoint agreement are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Peers read published checkpoint verification claims and digests, not the local scratch files; successful proof output is unchanged.

downtime.detail: A member without the required scratch, SQLite temp and live-writer headroom refuses its checkpoint proof and reports the deficit; the live daemon continues.

manual.detail: Before merge, Ops records allocated live DB and available live, scratch and SQLite temp bytes for linux-a, linux-b, mac-a and mac-b and evaluates the gate. The 16:13 UTC census conditionally passes linux-a, linux-b and mac-a, but mac-b refuses. An in-process SQLite temp-directory override and concurrent writers remain unknown. No production database copy or config change is required.

recovery.detail: A later checkpoint pass sweeps marked proof orphans under the proof lock. Unknown or unremovable files keep proof refused and report their paths until cleared.
